details:
Description

When saving searches in VRChat's world/avatar finder, the three pinned/saved search slots become locked and cannot be deleted. Once all three slots are filled with saved searches (shown with checkmark indicators), there is no way to remove individual entries or reset the slots. This prevents users from adding new searches when all slots are occupied.

Reproduction Steps

1. Open World Search or Avatar Search menu

2. Save 3 different searches to fill all available saved search slots

3. Attempt to delete any saved search by clicking the trash/delete icon

4. Observe that deletion option doesn't work or isn't available

Details

- Category: User Interface

- Frequency: Always
